2026

 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
 Anticipatory Bail Application No. 485 Of 2026
 Bhaskar Shamji Patil
 Versus
 The State Of Maharashtra

entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
... 
 Advocate for Applicant : Ms. Sarin Karishma Sanjay
 App for Respondents/State : Mr. R. K. Ingole

... 
 Coram : Mehroz K. Pathan, J.
 Date : 1st April 2026
Per Court :
1.

After hearing the submissions of the learned Counsel Ms.
Sarin for the Applicant as well as the learned App, it would be
appropriate to direct the Applicant to join the investigation and
cooperate by producing the necessary documents required for its
completion, as the learned App submits and alleges that the entire
record is in the custody of the Applicant.

2. Taking into consideration the aforesaid submissions, and also the submission that the Applicant is an 81-year-old Vice Chairman against whom there are no allegations of fraud committed by him, I am inclined to protect the Applicant until the further investigation papers and the updated case diary are received, subject to certain conditions.

In the event of arrest of the Applicant - Bhaskar Shamji Patil in connection with Crime No.202/2026 registered with Shahada Police Station, District Nandurbar for the offences punishable under Sections 477-A, 471, 468, 467, 465, 420, 418, 409, 406 and 120-B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, he be released on bail on furnishing P.R. bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousands) with two solvent sureties in the like amount, on the following conditions :

sentences.text: (b) The Applicant is directed to attend Shahada Police Station, District Nandurbar on 8th, 9th, 15th, 16th, 22nd and 23rd April of 2026 between 11:00 am. to 01:00 pm.
and co-operate with the Investigating Officer.
(c) The Applicant shall not tamper with the evidence and shall appear before the Investigating Officer as and when required, apart from the days already mentioned above.
(d) The Investigating Officer shall make the investigation papers available for perusal of this Court.

3. Stand over to 22.04.2026.
MEHROZ K. PATHAN JUDGE NAJEEB..
